Kondomanager supports two sending methods.

SMTP — the recommended method for everyone. Uses an external mail server (e.g. Gmail). Emails are delivered reliably without advanced configuration.

Sendmail — for advanced users with a VPS or dedicated server where Postfix is installed and SPF/DKIM records are configured in DNS. On shared hosting, emails will be rejected by recipients.

If you disable the database configuration, the .env file settings will be used.
